description: Answers "how loud is my neighborhood", "noise map by address", "how noisy is this address", "noise level in ZIP 78701". Modeled transportation noise (road + rail + aircraft, 24-hour average LAeq dBA) at a US street address, a 5-digit ZIP (sampled at the ZIP Code area center, approximate), a town or city name (sampled at the town center, approximate) or lat/lng, sampled block-by-block from the federal BTS 2020 National Transportation Noise Map. Returns a modeled dBA band, NOT a measurement; "below 45 dBA" means no modeled freeway/rail/flight path nearby (model floor, not silence). Continental US only.

address.description: US street address, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington DC"

lat.description: Latitude (use with lng instead of an address)

place.description: US town or city name, ideally with the state, e.g. "Boulder, CO"; sampled at the center of the town (Census 2023 places), so approximate

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP Code; sampled at the center of the ZIP Code area (Census 2023 ZCTA), so approximate

name: get_address_noise

approximate.description: "zip" or "place" when sampled at an area center rather than a street

band.description: Modeled dBA band, e.g. "60–70 dBA", or "below 45 dBA"

matched_address.description: Geocoder’s normalized address (when an address was given)

nearby_max_band.description: Loudest modeled band within ~90 m, if higher than the point

resolved_by.description: street, street_unit, zip, place, zip_from_street, place_from_street or point

street_matched.description: false when a street address did not match and its ZIP or town was used instead

title: Modeled transportation noise at a US address
